# TEP manipulated variables XMV(1..12)

Manipulated variables in `/PV/ XMV(1..12)` (current, corrected order of `teprob.f`). They are
**commanded** values: written by the native controller that owns them, or by the operator
(`set_xmv`) when that loop is in MAN or the plant is in MANUAL (`BaseTEPAdapter.set_manipulated_variable`).
The physical valve position `VPOS` is a TEP state (YY(39..50)) that follows XMV with first-order dynamics
(VTAU), so XMV is the command and VPOS the response.

The enterprise layer never writes XMV except through operator actions; the fault engine never writes
XMV (TEP-native valve sticking is IDV 14/15/19, handled inside TEFUNC).
